briefings.title: YouTube public views now count from the first frame
briefings.summary: Since 24 August 2026, a public YouTube view registers the moment playback starts, including hover autoplay, across long-form, Shorts, podcasts, and live. Historical totals were not restated; new plays use the new rule. Payouts and Partner eligibility still use engaged views (the old duration standard) in Analytics. In client reports, quote which number you mean: public views are reach, engaged views are attention.

briefings.title: EU designates ChatGPT as a search engine under the DSA
briefings.summary: On 31 August 2026 the Commission designated ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine (a hybrid service: it answers prompts, including by searching the web) and Reddit and Roblox as Very Large Online Platforms. All three declared at least 45 million average monthly EU users. They have four months to meet extra DSA duties on systemic risk, minors, elections, and illegal content — i.e. by January 2027. ChatGPT is not a VLOP; Reddit and Roblox are.

briefings.title: Markiplier takes ~8.5% of GoPro as Mission 1 Pro ships 2 Sep
briefings.summary: Mark Fischbach (Markiplier) took a large GoPro stake; Mission 1 Pro ILS hits retail 2 Sep. His review used an affiliate code without flagging the investment. Filmable short: would you disclose before or after the review? Accessible filmmaking vs an undisclosed skin in the game.

briefings.title: Clemmy’s Indie Fall Showcase is today (4pm London) with a Steam sale
briefings.summary: 100+ indie games on one YouTube stream, 1 Sep 16:00 London, with a week-long Steam curator sale (BIGFallShowcase2026). Watch-and-react: pick two titles, one-sentence wishlist-bait vs playable-demo take. Best film of the day for a game-shipper.

briefings.title: Instagram will cut Reels reach for unlabeled AI-person accounts
briefings.summary: Announced 31 Aug: ‘AI creator’ becomes ‘AI-generated profile’. Unlabeled synthetic-person accounts lose Reels/Explore recommendations; real people using AI edits are fine. Client angle: if a brand’s influencer is synthetic, disclosure is now distribution, not just ethics.

briefings.title: Chrome goes biweekly from 8 Sep (Chrome 153)
briefings.summary: Stable Chrome flips from a 4-week to a 2-week cycle starting Chrome 153 on 8 September. Agency/QA implication: shorter window to catch layout and API breaks. Tip: put clients on Early Stable or test Beta before the Tuesday drop.
